description: This file is a shell script that performs automated tests on git's 'rev-list --disk-usage' functionality, including setup, validation, and various option combinations.

methods.name: disk_usage_slow
methods.description: Calculates the total disk usage of objects in the repository by piping 'rev-list' output to 'cat-file' and summing object sizes.

methods.name: check_du
methods.description: Performs validation checks comparing 'rev-list --disk-usage' output with expected sizes, across different options.
